faqs.q: How can I verify a DHA Lahore plot file before purchasing?
faqs.a: Our advisory team conducts direct verification through DHA Lahore transfer branches and official records, ensuring zero risk. You can also visit our Phase 6 office for live verification assistance.

faqs.q: Do you assist overseas Pakistanis with remote real estate investments?
faqs.a: Yes! We manage end-to-end digital portfolio acquisitions, power of attorney facilitation, secure bank transfers, and virtual drone tours for overseas clients in the UK, USA, UAE, and Europe.

faqs.q: What documents are required to buy or sell property with Zalmi Marketing?
faqs.a: For buying: CNIC copy, passport-sized photos, and advance token payment. For selling: Original allotment/transfer letter, CNIC copy, token tax clearance certificates, and dues clearance certificate from DHA.

faqs.q: Can I schedule a guided site visit for DHA luxury villas?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Contact our direct hotline or WhatsApp concierge to book a private VIP vehicle tour of available villas and plots across DHA Lahore phases.
